commit.message:
perf(anglesolver): closed-form jump solver via constant-modulus dual

Replace the per-jump global search with a closed-form solve derived from the
problem's exact structure, cutting a single solve from ~73-202 ms to ~20-69 us
(~1000-3000x) while keeping every fixture byte-exact feasible.

Reformulation. Horizontal sprint-jump motion is linear in each tick's input
vector, which has a FIXED modulus (full sprint input) but a free direction (the
yaw). So maximizing/minimizing a landing coordinate subject to axis-aligned
position walls is a small constant-modulus QCQP:  max c.u  s.t.  A u <= b,
|u_t| = m_t. Dualizing only the linear walls gives the convex dual
  D(lambda) = sum_t m_t |c_t - sum_j lambda_j A_{j,t}| + b'.lambda,  lambda >= 0,
whose inner per-tick maximization is solved exactly, so there is NO duality gap:
at the dual optimum each input points along its friction-propagated costate,
u*_t = m_t * normalize(c_t - sum_j lambda_j A_{j,t}), which is automatically
primal-optimal by complementary slackness.

Solver. The dual is convex and tiny (one var per wall). It is minimized with a
hybrid that suits its geometry: a Levenberg-damped projected Newton step
(second order, kappa-independent) plus a projected-gradient fallback that
escapes the directions where the dual is locally flat (costates aligned with a
wall axis). Convergence is checked in costate space so degenerate optima (where
the multipliers wander but the recovered inputs are fixed) still terminate fast.

Quantization. The continuous optimum hugs the active walls exactly; MC's
65536-bucket sine table then perturbs the realized path, so walls are solved
with a small inward margin grown until the byte-exact ExactJumpModel re-check is
strictly feasible. The closed form returns null for cases it does not model
(facing/equality walls) and the engine falls back to the existing CMA-ES
multistart, so reliability is never reduced.

New: JumpLinearModel (linear structure + wall compilation + yaw recovery),
CostateDualSolver (the convex dual), ClosedFormSolve (orchestration + margin
ladder + exact verification), ClosedFormSolveTest. Removes the prior
smooth-basin + warm-started-CMA path (FastSolve, SmoothJumpModel,
SmoothGradientSolver) it supersedes.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Psn3J146S5KjRXYoZ9KLsP
